feeds.title: Nina-Marie Sayre
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Nina Marie; join me for a beautiful journey into the world of art quilts! In my blog, I share my passion, experience, behind-the-scenes, and inspiration for my art quilts. My blogs are concise, clear, include numerous photographs, and appeal to all types of quilters.

feeds.title: Terry Aske Art Quilt Studio
feeds.description: Hi! I am Terry, and I share tips and techniques that I developed, discovered, and refined during the years I've been quilting. I also share both art quilts and abstract/modern quilts that I create in a contemporary style.

feeds.title: True Blue Canadian
feeds.description: Hello there! I'm Dolores, and I've spent most of my life being passionate about quilting. In my blogs, I discuss my quilting adventures, try out new designs for my grandchildren, test out new patterns, and more.

feeds.title: Artquiltmaker Blog
feeds.description: Find commentary on the design, updates creativity, and works-in-progress of art quilts. The author, Jaye posts as often in an effort to keep track of what she is doing and entertain you all. She works on quilts collaboratively and individually, and is interested in the interplay of colors in quilt design, and enjoys working in series to study the effects that slight changes can have on a piece.

feeds.title: Bernina » Quilting
feeds.description: In our official blog, we publish creative quilting posts. Bernina has been passionately committed to developing cutting-edge sewing and embroidery machines for creative people and ensures that your creations can be implemented with the best technology.

feeds.title: Jo's Country Junction
feeds.description: Welcome! I'm Jo, a cross-stitching, machine quilting, and beagle-loving Grandma. I use my blog somewhat of a journal and open it up and let you all in. We discuss new designs, challenges, and other things related to our quilts. I love my family, quilting, reading, gardening, and cooking.

feeds.title: Nancy Zieman » Art Quilt
feeds.description: Nancy Zieman's blog provides the latest news, in-depth analysis, ideas, tutorials, new designs and more on art quilting. Nancy has written numerous how-to sewing and quilting books and designed patterns and products for New York-based companies.

feeds.title: The (not so) Dramatic Life » Art Quilt
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Cassandra, and you can read articles on art quilts provided in plain language for the general audience. The (not so) Dramatic Life offers longarm quilting services, original quilt patterns and designs, and handcrafted textile products.

feeds.title: SAQA
feeds.description: SAQA is a nonprofit organization that promotes art quilts to major art publications, museums, and galleries to educate the public about art quilts and serves as a forum for the professional development of quilt artists. It also acts as a resource for curators, dealers, consultants, teachers, students, and collectors.

feeds.title: Aqua Maroon Art Quilts
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Kathy, and I've been making art quilts since 2003. I routinely offer techniques and updates on my work. My work appeals to quilters of all skill levels. My quilts are best known for their originality, pattern, and color palettes.

feeds.title: Textiles Ranger » Art Quilts
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Gwen Lanning; join me as I take you on a lovely tour of the world of art quilts. My blogs are concise, unambiguous, and loaded with images.You will undoubtedly discover something that fits your style.

feeds.title: Leah Higgins » Textile Art
feeds.description: Heya! I'm Leah; my blog contains posts about my guests, studio visits, designs, and general updates on my quilting life. Most of my abstract quilts are inspired by the city I live in and the surrounding region's strong industrial heritage, while some are inspired by the effect of the place on my mental and emotional state. Keep an eye on my blog for more insights as such.

feeds.title: Quilting Daily » Art Quilting
feeds.description: Discover what art quilting is all about! Learn the techniques, and get inspired to make your own art quilt designs. Quilting Daily is dedicated to inspiring, educating, and equipping quilters of all interests and skill levels. In addition, we help you expand your skills, meet work-renowned art quilters, and take a front-row seat in this inspiring community.

feeds.title: Art Quilts Around The World
feeds.description: Welcome to Art Quilts Around The World. We are an ever-changing group of art quilters from all over the world. Every two months, we make a small art quilt challenge on a designated theme and share the results here on our group blog. You can find plenty of inspiration from our winning posts even if you decide not to participate.

feeds.title: Needle and Foot » Art Quilts
feeds.description: Welcome! I am Bernie, a quilter and a fabric shop owner. My blog features my quilting, sewing, crafting experiences, and a few random family musings. Needle and Foot is all about all things creative- quilting, sewing, crafting, thrifting, and up-cycling.

feeds.title: Sew Katie Did Blog
feeds.description: Read about Katie's quilting and sewing projects on the Sew Katie Did blog. It boasts modern quilts, sewing projects, tips, and tutorials that you can use! Her teaching and quilt designs fuse the tradition rooted in her childhood with improvisational techniques and a modern aesthetic. She teaches fun workshops accessible to all levels, locally and nationally.

feeds.title: Art East Quilting Blog
feeds.description: Our blog contains tips, articles, quilting updates, and more. Our patterns are cute, quirky, traditionally pieced, and come fully illustrated with step-by-step full-color instructions. They range in skill level, so whether you are new to quilting or are an old pro, we are sure to have a pattern to suit your skill set.

feeds.title: Eleanor Levie » Quilting Blog
feeds.description: Hi! Eleanor Levie here, a quilter of quilted presents such as pillows, table runners, tote bags, and embroidered coats who prefers to piece, machine-applique, and quilt with paint and dye and recycled packaging. I discuss art quilt techniques, ideas, instructions, and current quilting events in my blog. With us, quilters of every skill and confidence level design their own one-of-a-kind originals.

feeds.title: Quilt Improv Studio Blog
feeds.description: Hi! we are Giovanna Nicolai and Paola Machetta; we share advancements, new techniques, strategies, and information on Art and Improv quilting. We collect and combine our improvisations made with color, fabric, thread, and piecings, with all the usual Modern Patchwork tools.

feeds.title: SAQA NorCA/NV » Art Quilts
feeds.description: SAQA is a nonprofit organization promoting art quilts with an active community of 4,000+ artists, curators, collectors, and art professionals worldwide. With our exhibitions, resources, publications, and membership opportunities, we seek to increase the public's appreciation for the art quilt and to support our members in their artistic and professional growth.

feeds.title: Metropatch » Art Quilts
feeds.description: We showcase art quilts, art quilters, exhibits, and more. Our purpose is to provide an opportunity for quilters to gather for inspiration, education, and fellowship. Our society supports and encourages individual growth in skill and craftsmanship, and we celebrate quilting as a great American art form.

feeds.title: OP Quilt » Art
feeds.description: This is the art quilting blog of Elizabeth Eastmond, wherein she talks about art quilting-related topics. She shares her quilting adventures, tips, gallery visits, and more based on her several decades of experience. Her posts are concise, clear, and enclose numerous photographs.

feeds.title: Mulberry Patch Quilts » Art Quilt
feeds.description: At Mulberry Patch Quilts, quilting is our passion, so we help you make the finest quality quilts, accessories, & patterns. We constantly work on new ideas and post step-by-step descriptions and photos of the quilts. We've also combined our love of quilting and painting to create original art quilts.

feeds.title: Zippy Quilts » Art Quilt
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Mary, and In my blog, I post updates about my art quilts, showcase modern designs, talk about my gallery visits and talk to guilds. The majority of the quilts are my own design, and most of them are modern. The details about the quilting contests I occasionally enter can also be found in my blog.

feeds.title: Cindy Grisdela Art Quilt Blog
feeds.description: Welcome! I'm Cindy Grisdela, a fiber artist specializing in contemporary abstract work. I draw inspiration for my modern wall quilts by viewing nature outside my window every day, the details about which can be found in my blog. My abstract art quilts, like jazz music, are designed improvisationally without a preconceived pattern.

feeds.title: Laura Wasilowski
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Laura Wasilowski, and I combine vivid fabrics and whimsical stories to make my pictorial art quilts. My colorful, hand-dyed fabrics inspire me, as do stories of my family, friends, and home. These pieces often chronicle my life. At Artfabrik, we provide you with high-quality, colorful hand-dyed fabrics and threads that pleasure you.

feeds.title: Quilt Art Design
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Janeen, and all of my content focuses on quilting news, art, and pattern creation. My obsession with wildlife reflects in my art quilts. This beautiful world of art quilts is something I hope to encourage you to explore through my work.

feeds.title: A Few Scraps
feeds.description: Christina Cameli posts blogs and tutorials on free-motion quilting and more. When possible, she makes use of scraps and enjoys working without patterns. If you're ready to go deeper into the world of free-motion quilting, this is a great place to learn more!
